thread:
maria: FYI ACME Corp's virtual card on file didn't authorize before the 72h auth window expired for invoice INV-9123. Payment shows as `auth_timeout` from our gateway. Need plan for retry + customer outreach.

sam: Looking at gateway logs — got `402_authorization_expired` + `merchant_rejected`. I'll paste the raw snippet. :eyes:

sam: ```
{"id":"pay_7f9a","status":"failed","reason":"authorization_expired","attempts":1,"last_endpoint":"https://payments-gw/proc"}
```

sam: We can attempt a single immediate retry via the hosted invoice link, but gateway warns about duplicate auth attempts within 24h. Recommend schedule: 1) try hosted invoice email + card update 2) if no update after 24h, send wire instructions.

zach: +1 on hosted invoice. I'll tag CS to nudge the customer today. @nora can you take the outreach?

nora: On it. I'll send a short note asking them to update payment method or confirm they want a wire. Template I'll use: "We noticed your card on file couldn't be authorized. You can update your card here: <hosted-invoice-link>. If you'd prefer, we can provide wire instructions." Keep it tight. :email:

billing-bot: Automated notification: payment INV-9123 failed (code=authorization_expired) at 2026-11-08T14:02:03Z. Next retry allowed after 2026-11-09T14:02:03Z.

aaron: From infra side — if we do a retry we should force `force_new_authorization=true` on our retry call so the gateway doesn't attempt to reuse stale auth. Sample curl I propose:

aaron: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/retry \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAY_KEY' \n  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-9123","force_new_authorization":true}'
```

sam: That looks good. Note: some virtual cards decline programmatically when auth window closes; if retry fails, status becomes `permanent_decline` and we can't reattempt. So CS outreach timing is critical.

maria: Ok plan: Nora sends note now with hosted-invoice link and 24h deadline. Sam will queue a single retry after 24h if customer hasn't updated. If retry fails or customer requests, Zach will escalate to finance for wire setup. I'll draft wire instructions template now.

nora: Message sent to ACME contacts. Included link + two-line escalation path.

sam: I'll add a ticket in Payments with `priority:high` and schedule the automated retry job for 24h from now. Ticket: PAY-8342.

zach: Finance — when you get escalation, expect request for wire for $18,240. I'll include invoice pdf and proof of service.

maria: Thanks all. Quick checklist for the flow so we don't miss steps: 1) CS outreach (now) 2) wait 24h 3) automated retry w/ new auth 4) if fail -> wire offer & finance assist 5) mark customer as 'at-risk' in billing dashboard.

billing-bot: Reminder set: follow-up for INV-9123 in 24h (1899990123).

nora: will update thread when customer replies. :thumbsup:
